(5e) ch3 – P30 A particle which is at the origin at time 𝑡 = 0 has initial velocity,
𝑣0 = (−14.0𝑖̂ − 7.0𝑗̂ )𝑚/𝑠 and constant acceleration, 𝑎 = (−3.0𝑖̂ + 4.5𝑗̂ )𝑚/𝑠2
